title: A dissipative gauge theory of the brain protects tubulin qubits

statements.text: Brain processes can be described by a classical, dissipative, non-abelian $SU(2)$ gauge theory whose hidden quantum vacuum, near absolute zero, preserves coherence, so tubulin qubits can be processed there without decoherence.

sources.quote: Then tubuline-qubits can be processed in the quantum vacuum of the classical field theory of the brain, where decoherence is avoided due to the extremely low temperature
